senses.gloss: (v. בצבץ) to break through, divide; to ooze, trickle, drip.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 7:1:2">Y. Pes. VII, beg. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>כל העצים בּוֹצְצִין משקין</he> all other sorts of wood (used for roasting spits) will drip moisture. Y. M. Kat. I, beg. 80ᵃ; <cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 1:13">Tosef. Mikv. I, 13</cite> <he>ההרים בוצצין</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>ביצין</he>) the mountains are trickling (sending the rain water into the rivers; cmp. <cite ref="B01102">preced.</cite>).
